confidence_definition.high: The source explicitly identifies the vehicle and category/part, with an original number or clear model-specific compatibility statement.
confidence_definition.medium: The item is presented inside a vehicle-specific catalogue and has a part number, but individual fitment, variant, or year confirmation is incomplete.
confidence_definition.low: The source provides a model-filtered or category-level result but lacks explicit item fitment, or the item is unavailable/unverified.
confidence_definition.insufficient: No defensible vehicle-specific part evidence was found in the inspected sources.

insufficient_evidence_categories.general_reason: No explicit model-specific part record with compatibility and traceable part identity was verified in the inspected sources.

important_limitations: All non-Ethiopian supplier records are international evidence and must not be interpreted as Ethiopian retail prices or local stock.
Connect Drive prices and stock were not displayed; the pages request a quote.
BYD Yuan Up Connect Drive records have original numbers but no per-item model-year, variant, or fitment text.
ID.4 catalogue results may vary by model year, trim, drivetrain, and VIN; no interchangeability across ID.4 versions was assumed.
No final scoring or recommendation was performed in this batch.
